prompt:
Photograph of a single cutlass of about 1700 lying diagonally across a
plain flat light grey background, seen from above, its point at the
top left corner and its hilt at the bottom right: a short, broad,
slightly curved steel blade sharpened on one edge, a polished gilded
brass shell guard and knuckle bow shining gold, and a deep red grip
wrapped with fine gold wire, a round gilt pommel. Studio light, sharp
focus, realistic.
